description:
Intent i009 (peer-trusted-transport, snapshot s02) complete. Two medium-confidence findings, both verified by direct source reads with literal quotes confirmed in the tree:

Finding 1 — drivers/hv/hv_balloon.c:1353-1363 (balloon_down): the Hyper-V host peer's DM_UNBALLOON_REQUEST arrives in static recv_buffer[PAGE_SIZE] via vmbus_recvpacket (hv_balloon.c:1491-1493); hv_ringbuffer_read (drivers/hv/ring_buffer.c) bounds recvlen to PAGE_SIZE but the dispatch gate for this message type is only recvlen>0 (line 1495), while the sibling message type DM_MEM_HOT_ADD_REQUEST does validate hdr.size == sizeof(struct dm_hot_add) (line 1530) — asymmetric validation within the same vmbus dynamic-memory protocol. balloon_down() then does `int range_count = req->range_count;` (raw peer __u32, line 1357) and `for (i = 0; i < range_count; i++) free_balloon_pages(dm, &range_array[i]);` (1362-1363) with no clamp against recvlen/PAGE_SIZE or the guest's ballooned bookkeeping — OOB read past the PAGE_SIZE buffer; free_balloon_pages (1193-1206) then frees host-chosen PFNs via pfn_to_page(i+start_frame)/__free_page() with no pfn_valid() and underflows num_pages_ballooned.

Finding 2 — drivers/rpmsg/qcom_glink_native.c:787-790 (qcom_glink_rx_data): peer __le32 chunk_size/left_size from the SMEM fifo header are validated only by `avail < sizeof(hdr) + chunk_size`, where avail comes from glink_smem_rx_avail() (qcom_glink_smem.c:70-76) reading peer-writable SMEM head/tail acquired by qcom_smem_get — the bound is derived from the same attacker-controlled memory it validates; chunk_size is never checked against pipe->native.length or any kernel-known max. The intentless branch does `kmalloc(chunk_size + left_size)` (line 813, wrappable unsigned sum) and `qcom_glink_rx_peak(glink, intent->data + intent->offset, sizeof(hdr), chunk_size)` (850-851) trusting the raw peer field, while the sibling handler qcom_glink_handle_intent uses struct_size+avail checks — same-file clamped-vs-unclamped asymmetry.

Bounded negative evidence: greybus is absent from s02 (that variant family N/A); DM_BALLOON_REQUEST and the receive path itself were verified bounded (ring_buffer.c exact-length copy, alloc_balloon_pages PAGE_SIZE accumulation guard); seed usbip excluded by rule and not examined. Limitations: attacker model is the host/modem peer (semi-trusted), no runtime reproducer was built (read-only snapshot), and ntb_transport, 9p trans_fd/virtio/rdma/xen, nbd, virtio_net receive_mergeable, vhost/vringh, cifs/ceph reply parsers, hv utils channels, and xen pvcalls were only enumerated, not deep-read (recorded as unresolved candidates in the artifact). Artifact: agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked ["s02"], 2 findings, 12 candidates, 5 limitations.
